technical_specs.rendering: Natural skin, detailed fruit, accurate hands, moderate grain, and clean anatomy.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical photoreal 35mm street-style portrait of an adult woman with visible arm tattoos, blonde hair under a white patterned bandana, small oval glasses, and a calm expression. She wears a white short-sleeve high-neck blouse, relaxed pink athletic trousers without lettering, simple gold-toned jewelry, and a large plain quilted tote. She holds a fruit skewer and a clear container of cut fruit at a vibrant outdoor tropical night market. Fill the background with pineapple, mango, citrus, and dragon fruit in unmarked crates. Use bright practical market fixtures with warm cinematic fill, eye-level medium framing, natural skin, detailed fruit, accurate hands, moderate grain, and clean anatomy. No brand marks, tattoo text, stall labels, price boards, logos, readable signs, or text.
